entries.name: 固定镜头
entries.description: 机位与构图保持不动，让人物或环境在画面内发生变化。
entries.note: 固定镜头不等于静止照片；三格对照背景边缘不动、人物经过。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 推镜头
entries.description: 相机向主体靠近，画面逐渐收紧，同时改变前后景的透视关系。
entries.note: 推镜是机位移动；与只改变焦距的变焦推近分开观察。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 拉镜头
entries.description: 相机离开主体，逐渐显露更大的环境与人物所处空间。
entries.note: 拉镜改变机位和透视，不是简单把图像缩小。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 水平摇镜
entries.description: 相机位置基本不变，绕支点向左或向右转动观察方向。
entries.note: 对照横向扫过场景的过程；不要与相机横向平移混淆。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 俯仰摇镜
entries.description: 相机位置基本不变，镜头绕支点向上或向下转动。
entries.note: 摇镜改变指向；升降镜头则改变相机所在高度。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 横移跟拍
entries.description: 相机沿人物一侧移动并跟随，近处与远处物体产生不同的位移。
entries.note: 背景视差用于表达移动机位，人物可保持相近的画面大小。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 背后跟随镜头
entries.description: 相机在人物身后移动，跟随其进入或穿过空间。
entries.note: 主体背部保持可见，镜头与人物共同前进。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 环绕镜头
entries.description: 相机围绕主体移动，连续改变人物朝向与背景关系。
entries.note: 图例通过斜前、侧面、斜后关键帧表达环绕路径。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 升降镜头
entries.description: 相机整体升高或降低，改变观察高度和空间层次。
entries.note: 这里展示低位到高位；机位移动与单纯上下摇镜不同。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 甩镜头
entries.description: 快速摇向另一处，以运动模糊连接起幅与落幅。
entries.note: 中格刻意模糊，表示快速转向的过程，不是对焦失败。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 手持跟拍
entries.description: 用手持方式跟随人物，画面带有轻微不规则的位移或倾斜。
entries.note: 三格只示意不规则取景，不能从静态图还原真实晃动幅度。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 稳定器跟随镜头
entries.description: 相机跟随人物移动，尽量保持水平线、主体位置与运动连贯。
entries.note: 稳定拍摄不等于固定机位，也不必然等于长镜头。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 变焦推近
entries.description: 机位保持不动，通过改变焦距逐渐收紧取景范围。
entries.note: 对照背景与主体一起放大；与机位靠近的推镜不同。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 变焦拉远
entries.description: 机位保持不动，通过改变焦距逐渐扩大取景范围。
entries.note: 强调取景范围变化，而不是移动摄影机。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 滑动变焦
entries.description: 让机位移动与反向变焦配合，主体大小相对稳定而背景空间观感改变。
entries.note: 也称希区柯克式变焦或眩晕效果；图例不是精确光学标定。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 转焦镜头
entries.description: 在同一段镜头中把清晰焦点从一个距离层次转到另一个层次。
entries.note: 与静态浅景深不同，关注清晰对象从前景到后景的交接。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 慢动作
entries.description: 让动作在回放中显得更慢，突出动作阶段与细节。
entries.note: 三格只是相邻动作阶段示意，不表示实际播放速度或帧率。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 延时摄影
entries.description: 间隔采样并压缩时间，突出云、日影或人流等较长时间的变化。
entries.note: 固定构图中的时间跨度可以很大，与慢动作方向相反。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 高速快门凝固动作
entries.en: freeze action with a fast shutter
entries.description: 用较短曝光把快速动作记录得较清晰，突出关键瞬间。
entries.note: 这是摄影中的动作凝固，不等于视频定格或慢动作。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 慢门运动拖影
entries.description: 较长曝光让运动部位形成模糊或拖影，静止环境仍可相对清楚。
entries.note: 对照动态轮廓的延展；图例不提供精确快门参数。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 主观镜头
entries.description: 从角色的观看位置呈现所见对象，让观众暂时共享角色视点。
entries.note: 中格示意角色所见，前后格交代观看者；主观视点不是某一种固定景别。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 客观旁观镜头
entries.description: 从角色之外观察人物与空间，不直接代入某一角色的眼睛。
entries.note: 客观视点可以配合移动镜头，不等于固定机位。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 建立镜头
entries.description: 先交代地点、人物位置和空间关系，为后续近景提供环境背景。
entries.note: 建立镜头常用较宽景别，但建立功能与远景并非同义。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 反应镜头
entries.description: 把注意力放在角色对事件或他人话语产生的表情与动作反应。
entries.note: 图例从平静到察觉再到反应；不限定必须使用特写。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 插入细节镜头
entries.description: 短暂突出主动作中的关键细节，如拿钥匙的手或正在操作的物件。
entries.note: 细节仍属于主动作；区别于转向主动作之外的切出镜头。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 切出镜头
entries.description: 暂时切向主动作之外但与叙事有关的对象，再返回原场景。
entries.note: 图例以环境中的钟作为补充信息，不把它当作主动作的局部。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 空镜头
entries.description: 以环境或物件为主体，不让主要人物直接占据画面。
entries.note: 图例三格都不出现人物，表达环境、停顿或气氛；空镜不等于建立镜头。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 双人关系镜头
entries.description: 在同一画面中容纳两名人物，让距离、朝向和动作共同表达关系。
entries.note: 三格示意关系变化；不要求两人始终位于同一景深平面。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 正反打
entries.description: 在交流双方的观察方向之间交替切换，建立对话或对峙关系。
entries.note: 常保持轴线同侧，让双方在画面中的视线方向相向；轴线规则不等于不能有意越轴。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 视线匹配剪辑
entries.description: 将角色的观看动作与随后呈现的所见对象连接起来。
entries.note: 所见对象的方位与角色视线应形成可理解的空间关系。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 动作衔接剪辑
entries.description: 在动作进行中切换机位，让动作阶段衔接，保持时间与空间的连贯。
entries.note: 以开门过程为例，切换后延续同一动作，而不是重复完成一次动作。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 图形匹配转场
entries.description: 利用形状、位置或构图的相似性，将不同镜头连接起来。
entries.note: 图例用居中的圆形呼应；图形相似不代表两个场景在同一时间或地点。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 交叉剪辑
entries.description: 在不同地点的事件之间来回切换，常用来提示同时发生或相互关联。
entries.note: 三格按A—B—A组织；是否同时发生仍需剧情和上下文交代。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 跳切
entries.description: 从同一连续素材或近似机位中省去一段过程，产生可感知的时间跳跃。
entries.note: 同一环境中的人物位置或动作突然变化；三格只示意被省略的过程。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 蒙太奇段落
entries.description: 把多个时间或场景的片段组合，压缩过程或建立概念关联。
entries.note: 图例用准备、途中、抵达概括一段行程，并不代表逐秒连续拍摄。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

entries.name: 连续长镜头
entries.description: 在一次持续拍摄中展开人物行动，镜头内部不发生剪辑切换。
entries.note: 长镜头说的是持续时间与连续拍摄，不是长焦镜头；三格是同一镜头的关键帧。 图例按左→右阅读；静态分镜只表示关键阶段。

boards.title: 镜头运动与拍摄方式 · 固定、推拉与摇镜
boards.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept educational cinematography reference. Create an ORIGINAL LANDSCAPE contact sheet, approximately 1536x1024, organized as EXACTLY FOUR BIG CELLS in a 2 columns by 2 rows grid. Each BIG CELL contains ONE THREE-FRAME horizontal storyboard strip, read left to right. Therefore there are SIX narrow mini-frames across the entire canvas and TWO rows; a THICK vertical line at the exact midpoint separates the two stories, and a THICK horizontal line at the midpoint separates the rows. Thin separators divide the three consecutive moments INSIDE each big cell. Each story is self-contained, all its three frames remain in its cell. No titles, letters, words, numbers, icons or watermarks. Detailed cinematic semi-realistic anime illustration, strong visual continuity. Recurring clearly adult woman around 28 with a chestnut bob, a teal jacket over opaque cream crew-neck top, charcoal trousers and white sneakers. Usually a pale stone courtyard with arches, a foreground railing and trees. Natural nonsexual ordinary wardrobe. Show real scene images rather than cameras, film crews or diagram arrows. Preserve recognizable face and outfit within every story. Framing changes and parallax should make the particular film technique visually legible. TOP LEFT BIG CELL: LOCKED-OFF SHOT. Three times in one locked wide composition: woman enters from left, walks through center, exits toward right. The same arch and railing are in identical screen positions across all three frames, absolutely no camera movement. TOP RIGHT: DOLLY IN. Woman stands still, camera physically approaches: first full-body with foreground railing, next waist-up as railing grows and shifts with parallax, last chest-up with background perspective changed. BOTTOM LEFT: DOLLY OUT. Camera physically retreats from a face close shot, through waist-up, to a full-body wide view showing more courtyard and nearer foreground architecture. BOTTOM RIGHT: PAN RIGHT ON A FIXED PIVOT. Three successive horizontal views: begin on tree and woman near right edge, sweep through woman near center, end on right arcade with woman near left edge. Camera height and horizon unchanged; this is horizontal rotation, not moving sideways.
boards.edit_prompt: Edit only the bottom-right three-frame pan demonstration. The woman stands motionless at the same fixed world position. As the camera pans right from a fixed pivot, the stationary woman appears at the far right of the first frame, centered in the second frame, and at the far left of the last frame. Tree at left and arcade at right provide background landmarks. Preserve the top-left locked-off, top-right dolly-in and bottom-left dolly-out triptychs, overall grid and visual style. No text, arrows or labels.

boards.title: 镜头运动与拍摄方式 · 移动、跟随与环绕
boards.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept educational cinematography reference. Create an ORIGINAL LANDSCAPE contact sheet, approximately 1536x1024, organized as EXACTLY FOUR BIG CELLS in a 2 columns by 2 rows grid. Each BIG CELL contains ONE THREE-FRAME horizontal storyboard strip, read left to right. Therefore there are SIX narrow mini-frames across the entire canvas and TWO rows; a THICK vertical line at the exact midpoint separates the two stories, and a THICK horizontal line at the midpoint separates the rows. Thin separators divide the three consecutive moments INSIDE each big cell. Each story is self-contained, all its three frames remain in its cell. No titles, letters, words, numbers, icons or watermarks. Detailed cinematic semi-realistic anime illustration, strong visual continuity. Recurring clearly adult woman around 28 with a chestnut bob, a teal jacket over opaque cream crew-neck top, charcoal trousers and white sneakers. Usually a pale stone courtyard with arches, a foreground railing and trees. Natural nonsexual ordinary wardrobe. Show real scene images rather than cameras, film crews or diagram arrows. Preserve recognizable face and outfit within every story. Framing changes and parallax should make the particular film technique visually legible. TOP LEFT: TILT UP ON FIXED CAMERA POSITION. First frame looks at woman's shoes and paving, second at waist and torso, third at head and high arches/sky. Show vertical camera rotation rather than lifting the camera or zooming. TOP RIGHT: LATERAL TRACKING. Woman walks to the right in side profile while camera travels beside her, keeping her the same size and near center in all three frames; close railing shifts much more than distant arches, demonstrating parallax. BOTTOM LEFT: REAR FOLLOW SHOT. View from behind woman walking away through the arcade; camera moves forward with her, preserving medium distance and her on-screen size across three moments while columns pass by at edges. BOTTOM RIGHT: ORBIT/ARC SHOT. Woman stands still; camera moves around her: front three-quarter view, exact side profile, rear three-quarter view. Background architecture changes with the orbit. Do not just rotate the woman's head.

boards.title: 镜头运动与拍摄方式 · 升降、快速与稳定方式
boards.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept educational cinematography reference. Create an ORIGINAL LANDSCAPE contact sheet, approximately 1536x1024, organized as EXACTLY FOUR BIG CELLS in a 2 columns by 2 rows grid. Each BIG CELL contains ONE THREE-FRAME horizontal storyboard strip, read left to right. Therefore there are SIX narrow mini-frames across the entire canvas and TWO rows; a THICK vertical line at the exact midpoint separates the two stories, and a THICK horizontal line at the midpoint separates the rows. Thin separators divide the three consecutive moments INSIDE each big cell. Each story is self-contained, all its three frames remain in its cell. No titles, letters, words, numbers, icons or watermarks. Detailed cinematic semi-realistic anime illustration, strong visual continuity. Recurring clearly adult woman around 28 with a chestnut bob, a teal jacket over opaque cream crew-neck top, charcoal trousers and white sneakers. Usually a pale stone courtyard with arches, a foreground railing and trees. Natural nonsexual ordinary wardrobe. Show real scene images rather than cameras, film crews or diagram arrows. Preserve recognizable face and outfit within every story. Framing changes and parallax should make the particular film technique visually legible. TOP LEFT: CRANE UP. Camera starts low looking upward at woman, rises to eye-level full-body, finishes high looking down at crown and shoulders and paving. Woman stays at the same ground location; actual elevated viewpoint changes. TOP RIGHT: WHIP PAN. Woman clearly framed in first frame, middle frame is a strong horizontal motion-blur streak with no legible face, third frame lands sharply on a second clearly adult person in a brown jacket in the SAME courtyard. Only this cell includes a second adult. BOTTOM LEFT: HANDHELD FOLLOW. Three adjacent moments of woman walking, medium framing, slightly irregular camera position and small alternating horizon roll, natural observational feeling. Keep buildings straight within each frame rather than deforming them. BOTTOM RIGHT: STABILIZED WALKING FOLLOW. Three moments of walking woman from the front, camera travels backwards smoothly; she stays central at the same size, horizon perfectly level, consistent headroom and passing architecture. Contrast stable framing with the handheld cell.

boards.title: 光学与时间表现 · 变焦与转焦
boards.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept educational cinematography reference. Create an ORIGINAL LANDSCAPE contact sheet, approximately 1536x1024, organized as EXACTLY FOUR BIG CELLS in a 2 columns by 2 rows grid. Each BIG CELL contains ONE THREE-FRAME horizontal storyboard strip, read left to right. Therefore there are SIX narrow mini-frames across the entire canvas and TWO rows; a THICK vertical line at the exact midpoint separates the two stories, and a THICK horizontal line at the midpoint separates the rows. Thin separators divide the three consecutive moments INSIDE each big cell. Each story is self-contained, all its three frames remain in its cell. No titles, letters, words, numbers, icons or watermarks. Detailed cinematic semi-realistic anime illustration, strong visual continuity. Recurring clearly adult woman around 28 with a chestnut bob, a teal jacket over opaque cream crew-neck top, charcoal trousers and white sneakers. Usually a pale stone courtyard with arches, a foreground railing and trees. Natural nonsexual ordinary wardrobe. Show real scene images rather than cameras, film crews or diagram arrows. Preserve recognizable face and outfit within every story. Framing changes and parallax should make the particular film technique visually legible. TOP LEFT: OPTICAL ZOOM IN from a FIXED POSITION. Woman stays motionless, three frames progressively crop from full-body to waist-up to chest-up. The distant facade and woman enlarge by similar magnification; foreground and background perspective relationships stay the same, no new side of objects revealed. TOP RIGHT: OPTICAL ZOOM OUT, the reverse sequence from chest-up through waist-up to full-body, no camera travel. BOTTOM LEFT: DOLLY ZOOM. Woman stays chest-up at almost EXACTLY THE SAME on-screen size and position across all three frames; background arcade changes dramatically in apparent scale and spatial depth while the camera moves and lens changes oppositely. Do NOT simply zoom the woman bigger. BOTTOM RIGHT: RACK FOCUS. Foreground brass key on a low stone ledge, woman standing in background. First key sharp/woman blurred; middle focus transitioning with both a little soft; last key blurred/woman sharp. Same camera framing in all three rack-focus frames.

boards.title: 光学与时间表现 · 时间与快门
boards.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept educational cinematography reference. Create an ORIGINAL LANDSCAPE contact sheet, approximately 1536x1024, organized as EXACTLY FOUR BIG CELLS in a 2 columns by 2 rows grid. Each BIG CELL contains ONE THREE-FRAME horizontal storyboard strip, read left to right. Therefore there are SIX narrow mini-frames across the entire canvas and TWO rows; a THICK vertical line at the exact midpoint separates the two stories, and a THICK horizontal line at the midpoint separates the rows. Thin separators divide the three consecutive moments INSIDE each big cell. Each story is self-contained, all its three frames remain in its cell. No titles, letters, words, numbers, icons or watermarks. Detailed cinematic semi-realistic anime illustration, strong visual continuity. Recurring clearly adult woman around 28 with a chestnut bob, a teal jacket over opaque cream crew-neck top, charcoal trousers and white sneakers. Usually a pale stone courtyard with arches, a foreground railing and trees. Natural nonsexual ordinary wardrobe. Show real scene images rather than cameras, film crews or diagram arrows. Preserve recognizable face and outfit within every story. Framing changes and parallax should make the particular film technique visually legible. TOP LEFT: SLOW-MOTION KEYFRAMES. Same framing of adult woman gently tossing a red scarf, three very closely spaced stages with the scarf and fingers incrementally changing position, silky fabric suspended in air, sharp graceful continuous motion. Do not draw multiple overlapping bodies in one frame. TOP RIGHT: TIME-LAPSE KEYFRAMES. Identical locked courtyard view with woman seated small at a bench; frame one morning long shadow from left, frame two noon short shadow, frame three late afternoon long shadow toward right, clouds and passersby positions change. BOTTOM LEFT: FAST-SHUTTER FREEZE ACTION. Adult woman makes a small jump: three crisp sharp photos of takeoff, airborne pose, and landing, trouser fabric and hair tack sharp without motion blur. Show all feet within frames, ordinary opaque clothing. BOTTOM RIGHT: SLOW-SHUTTER MOTION BLUR. Same stone courtyard architecture stays crisp, walking woman has visible soft directional blur and trailing limbs in each of three moments. No extra anatomically solid arms; blur represents movement. These are illustrative keyframes, no numeric camera settings.

boards.title: 叙事功能与视点 · 视点与叙事功能
boards.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept educational cinematography reference. Create an ORIGINAL LANDSCAPE contact sheet, approximately 1536x1024, organized as EXACTLY FOUR BIG CELLS in a 2 columns by 2 rows grid. Each BIG CELL contains ONE THREE-FRAME horizontal storyboard strip, read left to right. Therefore there are SIX narrow mini-frames across the entire canvas and TWO rows; a THICK vertical line at the exact midpoint separates the two stories, and a THICK horizontal line at the midpoint separates the rows. Thin separators divide the three consecutive moments INSIDE each big cell. Each story is self-contained, all its three frames remain in its cell. No titles, letters, words, numbers, icons or watermarks. Detailed cinematic semi-realistic anime illustration, strong visual continuity. Recurring clearly adult woman around 28 with a chestnut bob, a teal jacket over opaque cream crew-neck top, charcoal trousers and white sneakers. Usually a pale stone courtyard with arches, a foreground railing and trees. Natural nonsexual ordinary wardrobe. Show real scene images rather than cameras, film crews or diagram arrows. Preserve recognizable face and outfit within every story. Framing changes and parallax should make the particular film technique visually legible. TOP LEFT: POINT OF VIEW sequence. First woman in side close-up looks toward a wooden doorway; second shows doorway from HER eye position, with only a tiny hint of her teal sleeve/hand at lower edge and no external view of her face; third returns to her small acknowledging expression. Do not put text on the doorway. TOP RIGHT: OBJECTIVE OBSERVER. Three outside-observer medium-wide views of woman crossing courtyard and pausing beside a bench; viewer sees her whole person from an external position, no first-person hands.
